about: Why the library keeps the clips the sensors flag (PLAN.md WP-5.8; tools/qa/verdict.ts). The writers (npm run import, npm run migrate) record each clip's verdict in its quality: pass, or baselined with a reason that names the level and the metrics past it, then a reason given here for that clip and metric, else its set's, else the warn level's, else how the clip stands to its source (as captured or as keyed, its fit, what its repair did), and last the metrics its tags' profile turns off. npm run qa -- library --check reads every clip's again and names a reason here whose finding is gone; floats, offFeet and unplanted answer its float and off-feet checks, and still answers its still check: why a clip that never moves, though no tag says it is a pose, stays so (F.13). Its shape: tools/qa/qa.schema.json.
warn: short of every fail level the sensors apply (thresholds.ts)

sets.QUATERNIUS_3D2DGE: as migrated from Quaternius's Universal Animation Library, with no source frames to measure a repair against: its keys stay the source's (WP-1.5) until the re-import can fetch its files (D63)

MESH2MOTION/Ledge_Hang.penetration: it hangs by the hands, legs dangling and toes pointed, with its hips at standing height: the toes reach below the floor, which a ledge replaces where it plays

MESH2MOTION/Zombie_Rise.penetration: it rises out of the ground: the hips start 40% of their height under the floor, on purpose

floats.CMU_CURATED/Ballet_Pirouette: it turns in relevé, risen onto the balls of its feet: the hips rise 20–30 mm over their standing height with the heels
floats.CMU_CURATED/Shoot_Bow: its source take (CMU 79_86) holds the left heel 60–70 mm up throughout and the hips 40–70 mm over where the subject's other takes stand them (966–984 mm), while the right foot's toes touch down at 3.5 s: a floor under the heels would sink those toes 40 mm, so it keeps the one its toes show (D69)
floats.CMU_CURATED/Stretch_Yawn: it rises onto its toes as it reaches up: the hips rise 40 mm over their standing height with the heels

unplanted.CMU_CURATED/Boxing_Guard_Loop: a boxer's guard, stepping in place: its feet skim between stances (neither sole lifts past 7.4% of H0), so the height pass holds both through each step and the planter pulls an ankle 16% of H0; read still, the right foot holds 50 ms a cycle and the left never, a contact that would drift the stance 0.27 H0/s (D108, D122)
unplanted.MESH2MOTION/Run_Anime: a run on the spot whose feet sweep the floor under a root that stands still: each foot is down a third of the loop, sweeping at a median 5.3 to 5.5 H0/s, so none holds still, and planting the feet the height pass finds would pull an ankle 1.5 H0 (D108, D122)
unplanted.MESH2MOTION/Run_Stealth: a stealthy run on the spot whose feet sweep the floor under a root that stands still: each foot is down about half the loop, sweeping at a median 7 to 8 H0/s, so none holds still, and planting the feet the height pass finds would pull an ankle 1.25 H0 (D108, D122)
unplanted.STYLE100/WideLegs_Walk: a retargeted wide-legged walk whose feet slide outward on the floor: the left drifts forward and out at 0.21 H0/s and never lifts past 6.9% of H0, the right slides back at 2.4 times the captured speed (0.64 against 0.27 H0/s); held as the height pass finds them, both feet give 0.94 of the captured speed but the planter pulls an ankle 13% of H0, and read still the right foot alone gives 2.3 times it (D108, D122)
unplanted.STYLE100_BACKRUN/Drunk_RunBack: a retargeted stumbling run backward whose feet never leave the floor (their soles within 0.8 and 4.2% of H0), so the height pass holds both all loop and the planter pulls an ankle 30% of H0; read still, only the left holds (0.28 s a cycle): the right slides at 1.9 times the captured speed (1.02 against 0.54 H0/s), still no more than 50 ms a cycle even against it, and the left's contacts alone would move the body at 0.79 of the captured speed (D108, D122)

still.QUATERNIUS_3D2DGE/Driving_Loop: frozen in its pinned source, not by this library's fit: my-3d2dge@14a561c fitted Quaternius' Driving_Loop within a fixed 30 mm, which took its motion (13 mm at most in Mesh2Motion's copy) for noise and kept its two ends, one pose (D133), and the migrator carries that format-1 clip as it is; the same animation keeps its motion as MESH2MOTION/Driving (Mesh2Motion's re-export of it, re-imported within half its reach, F.13), and Quaternius' own edition waits on its download (D63, D81)
